description: Infrastructure - Infrastructures de recharge de (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Rochelle. This dataset lists the electric vehicle charging stations available in the car parks of the city of La Rochelle. The data are proposed according to the schema available on schema.gouv.fr and according to Decree No. 2021-546 of May 4, 2021 At present, the unique identifier of each terminal provided by AFIREV is missing. Coverage: La Rochelle. The portal shows the English title as "Infrastructure - Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (EVRI)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Rochelle. Its keywords include parking, irve, recharge, electrique, station, stationnement. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
